title.narrative: STA - Support to Tax Administration Albania 2026 - 2030
STA - Support to Tax Administration Albania 2026 - 2030

description.narrative:
To support the development of a modern and well-governed tax administration capable of implementing EU-aligned tax legislation, providing consistent taxpayer services and managing information according to recognised standards. Strengthened institutional capacity contributes to improved domestic resource mobilisation and supports Albanias broader EU integration and public-sector reform.
The project focuses on three main outcome areas: (1) strengthening GDTs readiness for EU accession through preparation of draft EU-aligned legislation, supporting documentation and institutional readiness for future data exchange with EU systems (without including IT development) (2) improving taxpayer service quality and trust in the tax administration through implementation of the GDT Taxpayer Service Strategy, harmonised communication and strengthened call-centre routines (3) strengthening institutional governance through clearer roles, harmonised business processes and improved non-IT data governance and information-security practices aligned with ISO 27001.

Stötta utvecklingen av en modern, förutsägbar och välfungerande skatteadministration med kapacitet att implementera EU-harmoniserad skattelagstiftning, erbjuda god service till skattebetalare och hantera data enligt satt standard.

To support the development of a modern, predictable and well governed tax adminsitration capable of implementing EU aligned tax legislation, providing consistent taxpayers services and managing data accoridng to recognised standards.
